# Potjielek-Lekker

> Individual Tabletop Mini Potjie Setups for Interactive Indoor Dining & Events.

## Overview

Potjielek-Lekker offers complete mini potjie pot setups designed specifically for indoor dining tables. Each guest receives their own cast-iron pot, burner stand, and wooden base board, creating an interactive dining experience for family gatherings, functions, and holiday occasions.

## Product Features & Complete Sets

- Mini Cast-Iron Potjie Pot: Individual serving sizes for personalized meal preparation directly at the table.
- Table-Safe Stand & Burner Cup: Engineered stand with integrated burner cup and protective wooden under-board to keep dining tables safe.
- Social Dining Concept: Designed for group functions, dinner parties, and special celebrations where each person cooks their own meal.
- Direct WhatsApp Ordering: Seamless package orders and inquiries routed directly via WhatsApp integration.
